rektion: in etw. (Dat.) / hinter etw. (Dat.) verschwinden; aus etw. (Dat.) verschwinden
definition_de: nicht mehr zu sehen sein; weggehen, sodass man jemanden/etwas nicht mehr findet (Mein Schlüssel ist verschwunden. Die Sonne verschwindet hinter den Wolken.)
example_de: Langsam ging der Wanderer den Weg hinauf und verschwand nach wenigen Metern im dichten Nebel.
example_en: The hiker slowly walked up the path and disappeared into the thick fog after a few metres.
visual_idea: Collocation 'im Nebel verschwinden': the path is sharp in the foreground and a hiker is only a faint ghostly outline swallowed by thick fog, a result state that image models draw well (a magician's empty hat would read as 'zaubern', a lost key shows nothing). ver- = away. Disappearing is a change over time, so a first+last-frame video starts with the hiker clearly visible and ends with this card frame.
image_prompt: static view along a narrow gravel mountain path rising straight away from the camera between wet grass and low rocks, thick white fog filling the frame beyond ten metres, soft grey morning light; far up the path, barely visible, the faint pale ghostly outline of a hiker in a red jacket with a grey backpack, almost completely dissolved into the dense fog, the path and grass in the foreground sharp and clear
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_start_prompt: static view along a narrow gravel mountain path rising straight away from the camera between wet grass and low rocks, thick white fog filling the frame beyond ten metres, soft grey morning light; a few metres up the path a hiker in a red jacket with a grey backpack walks away from the camera, clearly visible and sharp, the fog thick and white ahead of him
video_prompt: static camera along a gravel mountain path: a hiker in a red jacket with a grey backpack walks slowly up the path away from the camera into thick white fog, his figure grows paler and fainter with every step until only a faint ghostly outline is left in the fog
